quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part I

dialogue.t: The strangely-shaped stone lantern seems to be emitting an ominous energy.
This stone lantern is so strange... It's so creepy.
Oh, what's that written on the light post?
"Travelers passing through: if you have any questions about this ward, please go to the Musoujin Gorge and talk to Mr. Kaji about it."
The handwriting looks very recent, and there are a few lines of smaller handwriting below, which have been eroded by the rain:
"Please tell Mr. Kaji we've tried... But unfortunately... Maybe he can find it somewhere nearby..."
"Please tell Mr. Kaji to come to the refuge as soon as possible. He's dearly missed by his family."
This Mr. Kaji seems to be pretty concerned about these stone lanterns. Why don't we go to Musoujin Gorge and ask him?
The lantern has finally been repaired. The weather seems to have changed as well.
You gaze at the ward, and suddenly, a strange energy flows towards you.
You realize that it is not resisting you, but is asking you for something...
Something seems to be missing from this ward. Best to look around the area for the missing parts.
Use your Elemental Sight to scan for scattered traces of elements nearby. Maybe you'll find something!
It seems that two critical components are missing from the ward.
How're things going? Have you finished repairing the wards already?
It's fine. Take your time.
Not bad, outlander! The clouds are almost gone. It seems as though my guess was right.
Next, the two wards at the Serpent's Head and Jakotsu Mine still need to be repaired.
If you don't mind, I'll leave those two wards to you, too.
Thank you very much for your help. Although I am by no means a man of wealth, I promise that you will be paid fairly.
I still don't know when it'll happen, but it seems that the time for my reunion with family and friends is drawing a little closer...
By the way, you can find me on the west side of the island once you're done. Fort Mumei came under rebel assault previously, and I suspect that the attack is related to these changes.

quests.description: A rock pillar stands sentinel at Musoujin Gorge, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it…
